Class TextImage

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.TextImage
public final class TextImage extends Object
Coloured floating text: the lines drawn into a picture (Colours codes, any colour, gradients) and hung in the world on one flat model that reads the right way from both sides. Made with Holograms.coloured(String, String, Vector3d, Supplier).

Unlike plain floating text it is one picture for everyone: lines are in the server's language and placeholders show the same value to every player (server-wide ones such as {lottery_pot} work; "your balance" ones do not). Each new text is a new picture sent to every player, so it is drawn again at most every MIN_REDRAW_MS. Its foot is at the position. By default it faces every player at once: each player's own copy of its turn is rewritten on the way out to face them, many times a second while players move. Since API_VERSION 3.
